_comment: Pages the guard would block, taken out of the index on purpose. Hand-written: a machine may never add a row here. Each entry costs the traffic it names, so it says who decided and why.

exceptions.reason: German blog index. One click in the 28 days to 2026-08-11, and 6 of its 7 impressions were the query 'volcast'. /de/ ranks 1.0 on that same query with 55.6% CTR, so the click has a better page to land on. Part of the brand consolidation that noindexed all 18 listing pages.
